description: One eval: what it targets (Workbench flow + stage, or external), its dataset and rubric ids, the rubric criteria it scores with (the snapshot taken at creation), schedule + runOnPublish + regression settings, run counts, latest score, and `binding` health (datasetOk / flowOk false = a run would fail at resolution — say so before proposing caliper_evals_run). Get the evalId from caliper_evals_list or caliper_flow_performance.
